verdict.rationale: YYLO's `task start` freezes the target SHA, creates a dedicated branch/worktree and completes configured dependency hydration before work begins, so environment setup is automated (gh-4, docs-2). Benchmark candidates also run in private fresh repositories (docs-25). However, it builds worktrees from an existing local checkout rather than cloning a remote repo, and dependency hydration must be pre-configured by the developer rather than worked out by the agent. Missing for 10: evidence of cloning a remote repository, agent-driven self-configuration of its environment, details of how dependency hydration is configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.
